newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index eases 2.1 pts on VUB losses.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index eases 2.1 pts on VUB losses.

text.p: Slovak blue chips were mixed in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, with losses to VUB bank pulling the 16-share SAX index down 2.10 points to 193.70.
The two most heavily weighted Slovak issues, oil refinery Slovnaft and steel maker VSZ, both closed up, but brokers said they did not see this as the beginning of a trend.
"I expect them both to decrease very soon," Dusan Sykora of ING Barings said, adding that trading in Slovnaft was influenced mainly by the annual shareholders' meeting scheduled for Thursday.
Otherwise the bourse was as quiet as last week, Sykora said. "It is a poor business now, and I don't see any sign of change for the better in the near future," he added.
Overall volume increased to 551,648 shares from 197,951 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover climbed to 588.37 million crowns from 97.82 million crowns.
